title: moxy Scenario
description: A named bundle of moxy mock rules. The unit of sharing for moxy v1.1.

$schema.description: URL to this JSON Schema. Enables IDE autocomplete + CI linting.

moxyFormatVersion.description: Format version of the .moxy.json file. Decoupled from the moxy extension version.

name.description: Human-readable scenario name. Shown in the moxy library and used to derive the suggested filename on export.

description.description: Optional context for bug-report consumers (what broken state does this reproduce?).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the scenario was created or last serialized.

createdWith.description: Metadata about the moxy build that produced this file. Informational only.

rules.description: Mock rules. Evaluated top-down against each request; first match wins.

id.description: Source ID. Regenerated at import time as hash(match + mutate) for stable cross-machine identity.

behavior.description: Reserved for future per-rule stochastic fields (probability, jitter, repeat). v1.1 ignores.

matcher.description: Discriminated union by `type`. v1.1 supports only `url-glob`.

pattern.description: URL pattern. Uses native URLPattern when available; falls back to a minimatch-style glob (`*` = any chars except `/`, `**` = any chars including `/`).

method.description: HTTP method. `*` or empty string matches any method.

mutate.description: What to do when this rule matches. At least one of status / body / headers / latencyMs must be present.

status.description: HTTP status to synthesize. If absent and body is absent, the real status is passed through with only the latency/headers overrides applied.

headers.description: Response headers. In body-replace mode these are the only headers sent; in passthrough mode they merge into the real response's headers (overriding matching keys).

latencyMs.description: Delay before delivering the mocked response. In passthrough mode (no body), latency is added on top of the real request time.

mutateBody.description: Discriminated union by `type`. v1.1 supports text / base64 / json.

data.description: Plaintext / JSON-string / any UTF-8 payload. Max 5 MB.
Base64-encoded binary payload. Max 5 MB after encoding.
Arbitrary JSON value. moxy JSON.stringifies it when constructing the synthesized Response.
